original_query: In which year did Nestlé achieve higher Organic Growth, 2003 or 2004?

summaries.found_via_query: What were Nestlé's Organic Growth figures for 2003 and 2004?
summaries.summary: This slide from Nestlé's 2011 Full Year Results Roadshow (February 21st, 2012) displays 10 years of Organic Growth and EBIT Margin Improvement. It includes a bar chart showing annual Organic Growth percentages from 2001 to 2011, with 2003 at 5.1% and 2004 at 4.5%. The slide also notes 10-year annual averages of 6.4% for Organic Growth and 3.6% for Real Internal Growth.
key_facts: Data corresponds to published figures, not restated for accounting changes
